svg.title: Arduino Mega 2560 Rev3 with the GU256X64D-7000
svg.desc: Component-side Arduino and GU256X64D-7000 PW-1315-101 rear view. Arduino D2 to VFD D0 (CN3 · 7), Arduino D3 to VFD D1 (CN3 · 8), Arduino D4 to VFD D2 (CN3 · 9), Arduino D5 to VFD D3 (CN3 · 10), Arduino D6 to VFD D4 (CN3 · 11), Arduino D7 to VFD D5 (CN3 · 12), Arduino D8 to VFD D6 (CN3 · 13), Arduino D9 to VFD D7 (CN3 · 14), Arduino D10 to VFD PBUSY (CN3 · 3), Arduino D11 to VFD /WR (CN3 · 5), Arduino D12 to VFD /RESET (CN1 · 6). Arduino GND joins the external regulated 5 V PSU negative and VFD CN3 pin 1. The Arduino supply pin stays open. PSU positive goes to VFD CN3 pin 2, /RD at CN3 pin 6, and pull-up resistors for /WR and /RESET. Set JRB C–B for separate PBUSY at CN3 pin 3. CN3 pin 4 RS stays open.
svg.text: Set JRB C–B for PBUSY on CN3 pin 3. Leave RS (CN3 pin 4) open.
Arduino and VFD power share a ground. 10 kΩ is an example pull-up value.
